        ❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Indian Navy Agniveer SSR MR 01/2027 & 02/2027 Batches

        
            
                1. What is the application period for Agniveer SSR/MR 01/2027 & 02/2027 batches?
                Online applications are live from March 14, 2026 to April 6, 2026. Correction window: April 10–11, 2026. Apply only at joinindiannavy.gov.in.
            

            
                2. What is the age limit for these batches?
                Age: 17½ to 21 years on enrolment date.
                - For 01/2027: Born between Dec 1, 2004 – May 31, 2009 (approx).
                - For 02/2027: Born between May 1, 2005 – Oct 31, 2009 (approx).Exact DOB ranges vary slightly by branch—check official PDF notification.
            

            
                3. What are the educational qualifications?
                - Agniveer SSR: 10+2 with Physics & Mathematics + 50% aggregate (or equivalent diploma/vocational).
                - Agniveer MR: Matriculation (10th) with 50% aggregate.
                - SSR (Medical Assistant): 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology (PCB) + 50% aggregate & 40% in each subject.Candidates awaiting results may apply but must produce originals later.
            

            
                4. Who can apply (gender eligibility)?
                - Agniveer SSR & MR: Unmarried male and female candidates.- SSR (Medical Assistant): Unmarried male candidates only.
            

            
                5. What is the selection process?
                Stage I: Indian Navy Entrance Test (INET 2026) – Computer-based, objective (May 2026 tentative).Stage II: Shortlisting, PFT (Physical Fitness Test), Medical Exam.Final: Merit list & enrolment at INS Chilka.
            

            
                6. How to apply online?
                1. Visit joinindiannavy.gov.in.2. Register with Aadhaar/mobile/email.3. Fill form, upload documents.4. Submit before April 6, 2026.No offline/postal applications accepted.
            

            
                7. Is there any application fee?
                General/ OBC/ EWS : Rs.550/- & SC/ ST Candidates : Rs.550/-
GST Charge Extra : 18% - fee for Agniveer entries.
            

            
                8. When will admit card and exam date be released?
                Admit Card for INET 2026 expected ~7-10 days before exam (May 2026 tentative). Check portal regularly for updates.
            

            
                9. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
                Direct links available on joinindiannavy.gov.in under Agniveer/Recruitment section (separate PDFs for SSR, MR, SSR Med).
            

            
                10. Any tips for Bihar candidates (Darbhanga region)?
                High competition—prepare early for INET (English, Science, Maths/Reasoning, GK). Focus on physical fitness (1.6 km run, push-ups, etc.). Apply from reliable internet; contact helpline if login issues.
            
        

        Note: Always refer to the official website joinindiannavy.gov.in for latest updates, as dates/eligibility may vary slightly per batch/notification.
